own_solution.law: Metre bridge balance X = R (Lw - l)/l; rho = X (pi d^2/4)/Lx
assumptions: uniform bridge wire, negligible strip/lead/contact resistance
balance with box in left gap at l = 41.5 cm

notes: All claims agree with pass 1. Checked R answers: q=4.6 -> 16.6x58.5/41.5 = 23.40 Ω, rho = 1.1027e-6; q=9.4 -> 30.166 Ω, rho = 1.4216e-6; q=17 -> 40.88 Ω, rho = 1.9264e-6 Ω·m. Base 7.9713e-7 Ω·m. Bridge-wire diameter cancels in the length ratio (C) correctly. Minimal pairs: T0506/T0CEE differ only in rheostat vs box, same 9.4 Ω; TAB0A/T459C differ only in 'earlier trial only' vs 'before the galvanometer was brought to zero', same 9.4 Ω. TD741 and TE5F9 are declared numeral-free twins, so their lack of a number (which I noted in pass 1) is by design, not a defect. Input units cm/m/mm are converted consistently.
